Gamers put their addiction above their family life, meeting with friends and going to school. As a result, people get fired for not going to work or miss school classes for a longer period of time. Many 34 with their addiction, even if they see and realize the negative consequences it leads to.

mcq.q: According to this passage, what animal uses smell to drive away attackers?
mcq.passage: Nature is a battlefield. You are either eating or being eaten. To survive, animals develop many ways to protect themselves from attackers. A hard shell is an excellent defense for slow-moving animals like turtles, snails, or clams. Some animals, like skunks, spray bad smells when threatened so that other animals will leave them alone. Certain animals try to fool their enemies by looking like something harmful. For example, some butterflies have big spots that resemble the eyes of an owl. The king snake, one of the most widespread snakes in the U.S.A., has red, yellow and black rings that look like the markings of a smaller but more dangerous coral snake. Other animals protect themselves by forming groups. Whether it’s a pod of whales, a school of fish, or a pride of lions, living in groups helps animals defend each other against enemies and stay alive. Still other animals blend into their environment to become invisible. The Arctic hare, for instance, changes its coat color from brown in the summer to white in the winter, disappearing against the snow. These are just a few of the clever ways animals protect themselves in nature.

mcq.q: According to the passage, which of the following statements is true about Matcha?
opts: The history of Matcha tea began in Japan.
Matcha and black tea share a common origin.
Matcha is a new discovery in the 20th century.
Matcha tastes bitter because it is full of nutrition.
mcq.passage: Matcha is more than just green tea in Japan but a symbol of Japanese culture and tradition. It was first planted in China during the 12th century and introduced to Japan later. It can be enjoyed as a drink, dessert and healthy treat. Few know that it actually comes from the same plant with black tea. Yet, it has a sweeter flavor because of shading, a process in which farmers cover the tea plants for 20 to 30 days before the tea leaves are picked. The covering practice reduces the amount of sunlight the plants receive. Though the growth of tea plants is slowed down, it gives Matcha the richer taste and deeper green color. More and more people are rediscovering Matcha in today’s world of health. They have a cup of Matcha before work rather than coffee. With higher levels of nutrients, it increases energy levels and improves moods without the side effects of coffee.
